name: Hitec Food Equipment Inc
old_description: SAUSAGE HIGH SPEED LINKING AND HANGING SYSTEM FOR ALL TYPE CASING
about:
Hitec Food Equipment Inc. The parent company marked its 50th anniversary in 2026, and the U.S. entity sells and supports the full line of sausage and ham stuffing systems across the Americas.

The company designs and builds high-speed linking and hanging systems for natural, collagen, and artificial casings, along with vacuum stuffers, formers and dividers for hamburger and ball products, flow dividers with ball-forming cutters, food transfer pumps, pressure control units, sausage peeling machines, and cutting equipment. Product families include the LINKWEL-X/XL, HITEC M-3X/3XL, STUFFWEL 51 and 219 series, HAMBURG FORMER, BALL FORMER, SPS pump models, EQ pressure controllers, SABRE peelers, and the HI-CUT3 cutter. Hitec also offers customization and automation integration services. Sister facilities in Thailand and Qingdao, China, extend manufacturing capacity, while a network of agents covers North and South America, Europe, Africa, and Asia–Oceania.

Primary customers are meat and sausage processors ranging from regional plants to multinational food companies. The equipment serves operations producing linked sausages, hams, formed patties, and portioned meat products. Agents in countries such as Canada, Mexico, Brazil, France, Germany, Thailand, and Australia provide local sales and service.

Hitec states that its development philosophy centers on tracking industry trends and incorporating them into new and improved machines, aiming to make equipment that contributes significantly to the meat and sausage sector. The company emphasizes standing behind its products with extensive support functions.

name: Hithium (Xiamen Hithium Energy Storage Technology Co., Ltd.)
old_description: Hithium is a Chinese battery energy storage system manufacturer that opened its first U.S. manufacturing/assembly plant in Mesquite, Texas in 2025 with 10 GWh annual capacity.
about:
Hithium, a Chinese battery energy storage system manufacturer, established its first U.S. manufacturing and assembly plant in Mesquite, Texas in 2025 with 10 GWh of annual capacity. The company, formally Xiamen Hithium Energy Storage Technology Co., Ltd., is headquartered in Mesquite. No founding year or founders are disclosed in the available information.

The company produces battery energy storage systems (BESS), battery modules, and stationary storage solutions. Its processes include BESS assembly and automated manufacturing. The Mesquite facility targets 10 GWh annual output, while global shipments have surpassed 200 GWh. The firm operates a "Lighthouse Factory" in Chongqing, recognized as the world's first for energy storage batteries.

Hithium serves utility, grid storage, commercial, residential, commercial & industrial (C&I), off-grid, and AI data center markets. Project examples include a 235 MWh installation in Colorado, a 150 MW/300 MWh system in Lianyungang, China, a 55 MWh project in Razlog, Bulgaria, a 421 MWh supply for GPG's Fraser Coast project in Australia, and a gigafactory investment in Navarre, Spain.

The company states its mission is to "let green energy benefit all, help strivers realize their dreams," with a vision to become a respected global green energy company with technology. It emphasizes end-to-end integrated capabilities, full-chain integration, and a "Li-Na Synergy" strategy combining lithium-ion and sodium-ion technologies.

name: HiveSentry
old_description: Bee activity sensors allow a beekeeper to check on his honeybees while at home, without having to make a trip to his apiary which may be up to one-half mile away. The Hive
about:
Maine Biosensors LLC, based in Dover-Foxcroft, Maine, developed the HiveSentry beehive monitoring system to give beekeepers a way to observe hive activity without traveling to distant apiaries.

The company produces a plug-and-play system comprising battery-powered sensors and a base station. Each sensor uses a pyroelectric infrared (PIR) element to detect the slight temperature rise of flying bees, reporting data every two minutes over a LoRa wireless link that can span up to half a mile. The base station displays real-time activity for up to four hives, flagging population changes, swarming, robbing, and intrusions around the clock. No internet connection is required, and installation does not alter the hive structure.

The primary customers are beekeepers managing apiaries that may be located up to a half mile from their home or workshop. The system serves hobbyist and commercial apiculture operations seeking continuous, non-invasive colony monitoring.

Maine Biosensors emphasizes that the sensors are completely passive, causing no disturbance to the bees, and that the long-range, stand-alone architecture eliminates the need for cellular or Wi‑Fi infrastructure at the apiary.

name: Hoag Electronics Product Design and Development Engineering
old_description: Hoag Electronics is an electronics engineering product design consulting company that specializes in the design and development of new electronic products.
about:
Hoag Electronics Inc. was founded in 1986 by Tom E. Hoag in Bellevue, Washington, about ten miles east of Seattle. The Washington State corporation began as an electronics engineering consultancy focused on designing new products for original equipment manufacturers in the wireless radio, telecommunications, and industrial control sectors.

The firm provides a turnkey product development service that spans schematic capture, multi‑layer PCB layout (up to eight layers), microcontroller hardware and firmware development, analog/digital/mixed‑signal circuit design, and RF wireless link design for IrDA, GPS, and Bluetooth. It also operates a contract manufacturing line for prototype and production‑run assembly, handling both surface‑mount and through‑hole components, and delivers complete documentation packages including schematics, bills of materials, and manufacturing data.

Hoag serves OEMs worldwide, with a historical concentration in wireless radio, telecommunications, and industrial control equipment. Clients range from startups needing a first prototype to established companies requiring production‑scale assembly and test services.

The company emphasizes its 25‑plus years of design experience, status as a Motorola Professional Radio Application Partner and Authorized Licensed Application Developer, and a commitment to fast turnaround, quality, and responsive client support as its primary differentiators.

name: Hobart Sales & Services.
old_description: Since 2008, Hobart is proud to be named ENERGY STAR Partner of the Year.
about:
Based in Fargo, North Dakota, the office operates as an authorized Hobart service partner under Jeffrey D. Doyle, Inc., providing factory-authorized repair and maintenance for commercial kitchen equipment. The location also maintains a parts counter with 40,000 stocked SKUs for immediate purchase.

Technicians handle cooking equipment (ovens, ranges, griddles, fryers), dishwashers (undercounter, door-type, conveyor, flight), food machines (mixers, slicers, processors, saws), weighing and wrapping stations, and HVAC systems. All technicians complete Hobart’s factory training and apprenticeship program, and service vehicles carry the extensive parts inventory to support a high first-call completion rate. Three service plans—Hobart Care, Hobart Assurance, and Hobart Prosurance—offer preventive maintenance and priority repair options.

The customer base includes independent restaurants, national chains such as Chick-fil-A, and other commercial food-service operators in the Fargo region. The office serves the broader hospitality and food-service industries, focusing on minimizing downtime for critical kitchen assets.

The partnership emphasizes rapid local response, a team-based technical approach where specialists collaborate on complex repairs, and adherence to Hobart’s service standards for the equipment the brand manufactures.

name: Hobby Hardwood Alabama
old_description: We are open Fridays and Saturdays for walk in retail sales from 9am to 4pm.
about:
Hobby Hardwood Alabama operates from New Market, Alabama, just north of Huntsville, where Robert and Martha Milton have run a family-owned sawmill and lumber yard for decades. The business began as a hands-on sawmilling operation and has grown into a destination for woodworkers seeking premium hardwoods.

The company produces ultra-premium domestic and exotic hardwood lumber across roughly 50 species, processing most logs in-house through its own sawmill and multiple kilns. Every board is hand-sorted, hand-trimmed, hand-flattened, and hand-edged to meet the company's proprietary HSP grade—zero knots, zero defects, and nearly 100% usable—far exceeding National Hardwood Lumber Association (NHLA) FAS standards that require only 83% usability.

Customers range from first-time hobbyists buying a single board to master craftsmen building heirloom furniture, cabinets, dining tables, and concert-quality guitars for venues such as the Grand Ole Opry. The shop also serves turkey call champions, local school bus drivers making cutting boards, and parents constructing cribs. Walk-in retail is available Fridays and Saturdays, with weekday appointments welcomed.

The Miltons founded the business on a simple premise: run a store they would want to shop in. That philosophy drives practices like encouraging customers to hand-pick boards, maintaining a clean, organized facility, and posting NHLA standards in the store for transparency. Robert Milton's national reputation—earned through sawmilling demonstrations, a charter membership in the North Alabama Wood Crafters club, administration of the world's largest sawmilling forum, and a YouTube channel where he is known as the "Sawmilling Professor"—underscores a commitment to expertise that the company says cannot be duplicated.

name: Hoboken Custom Craft
old_description: Hoboken Custom Craft is a full-service wood shop offering custom creations for both residential and commercial projects.
about:
Hoboken Custom Craft operates from a workshop in Hoboken, New Jersey. The company was founded by Anton David, managing partner of Avid Handyman and Construction, a locally owned and operated handyman and construction firm serving Hoboken, Jersey City, and surrounding areas. David established HCC as a sister company to provide clients with unique residential and commercial furnishings, assembling a team of designers, carpenters, and finishers.

The shop functions as a full-service woodworking operation, handling planning, design, fabrication, and installation. Its output ranges from simple storage solutions and full closet build-outs to heirloom-quality furniture pieces. Work is carried out in the company's Hoboken workshop by the in-house team of designers, carpenters, and finishers.

The business serves both residential and commercial customers. Projects have included custom closet systems for homeowners and furnishings for commercial spaces. The close relationship with Avid Handyman and Construction also allows HCC to extend its services to that firm's client base, providing turnkey solutions from conception through final installation.

The company's stated philosophy is to think "there is no box" rather than merely outside it, aiming to deliver cutting-edge designs without conventional restrictions. Clients are invited to participate in the fabrication process through progress photos or workshop visits, and projects can start from a Pinterest board, a napkin sketch, or a simple idea.

old_description: “Quality is just a word, and an empty word at that, if it doesn’t include harmony, balance, passion, intention, attention.”
about:
Holz Wood Shop operates from Miami, Florida, as a design and custom fabrication company specializing in fine furniture. The shop builds engineered pieces tailored to client specifications, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces custom furniture for residential and hospitality settings, including tables, bars, retail counters, shelving, and live-edge wood pieces. Its capabilities span CNC fabrication, traditional joinery, and full design services such as 3D renderings, shop drawings, and conceptual design packages. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Clients range from high-end residential customers seeking one-of-a-kind dining sets, desks, and bedroom furniture to hospitality operators needing bar installations, restaurant decor, and retail display fixtures. Project examples include a solid walnut gaming table, a custom kitchen island with a white oak top, a Baltic birch dining set with mortise-and-tenon joints, and built-in children’s room furniture.

Holz Wood Shop emphasizes traditional craftsmanship, the use of premium natural materials, and collaboration with local suppliers and artists to create unique, clean, high-quality pieces. The firm also offers proprietary product development and design consulting alongside fabrication.

name: Home Reserve
old_description: "From bold wine spills to big surprises, I asked for your most unforgettable Home Reserve stories. These are the ones I'll never forget."
about:
Home Reserve operates from Fort Wayne, Indiana, where it has been an American-owned and operated business for 25 years. The company manufactures modular sectionals and seating entirely in its Indiana facility, shipping orders within one week. No founders are named in the available materials.

The product line centers on configurable sectionals—deep-seat, standard, loveseat, chair, and ottoman models—built with sustainably sourced wood frames, CertiPUR-US® certified foam, and PFAS-free, machine-washable performance fabrics. Every component, from covers and cushions to frame parts, is designed to be individually replaceable, a feature the company calls Part-by-Part Renewability. To date, Home Reserve reports over one million units sold to more than 200,000 customers, with free shipping on all orders.

The brand sells directly to consumers, targeting households that value durability and adaptability. Reviews highlight families with young children and pets—one noting survival of “multiple spills within the first week” with two dogs and a toddler—and apartment dwellers who appreciate the easy-carry boxes that navigate tight stairways. The furniture has been featured on HGTV, Apartment Therapy, A&E, Better Homes & Gardens, and Dwell.

Home Reserve positions itself on longevity and low-waste ownership: a 10-year frame and hardware warranty, a 60-day no-risk trial, and $1 fabric swatches let buyers test materials before committing. The made-in-USA construction, stain-resistant fabrics, and built-in storage compartments are presented as the core reasons customers choose the brand over disposable alternatives.
